query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[2] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:25:00) Aunty Oby I appreciate that, genuinely. It's fine for now. Let's just get through this year and we can revisit the setup after. 😊
[4] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:28:00) Worth noting that 'fine for now' has been the answer for a couple of years. I think Aunty Oby is raising something real. Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:35:00) My children, Adaeze carries too much and she does not complain. I am proud of her. We will discuss this properly in December. God willing, we will sort it out as a family. Chisom, have you confirmed your dates? I need to know if you will be there from the 24th.
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:54:00) My children. This is good. Adaeze, I should have pressed harder sooner. I knew it was wearing on you. God willing, next year this will run differently. Thank you for speaking up. 🙏
[7] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:23:00) My children, Ifeoma is right. A standing order would save Adaeze having to send reminders every year. God willing, we should set that up in January. Adaeze, how much do we have so far? Is it enough for the usual gifts and the Christmas day food budget?
[8] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:44:00) okay so before we move on I need to say something about the Christmas fund. I love doing this but I genuinely need someone to share this with me this year - I nearly dropped it in November. six years is a long time to be doing the chasing and the reconciling alone. I'm asking properly now, not hinting. who will co-manage it with me from this December?
[9] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) Greetings my people. Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.
[10] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze is asking properly, not hinting, for someone to co-manage the Christmas fund with her from this December, as she nearly dropped it in November after six years of doing the chasing and reconciling alone.
[12] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Adaeze has been keeping a spreadsheet for the fund, now in its sixth year running, and current total is enough for gifts and food budget once Kingsley's second half arrives.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze will co-manage the Christmas fund with Emeka from this December, with Adaeze briefing him on the spreadsheet this week.
[14] (about=Chisom, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Chisom observes that Adaeze always says it's fine but it is never fully fine, and she sees her.
[15] (about=Chisom, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Chisom forgot to transfer her fund contribution and did it from her banking app on 2025-11-09, apologizing to Adaeze.
[16] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka and Adaeze have discussed privately; Adaeze will brief him on the fund process after Christmas.
[17] (about=Emeka, core, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Emeka says there is no 'thing' between him and Adaeze, denying any issue.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Adaeze will brief Emeka on the fund process after Christmas.
[19] (about=Ifeoma, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Ifeoma notes that 'fine for now' has been Adaeze's answer for a couple of years, and thinks Obiageli is raising something real, suggesting it should be on the agenda properly at some point.
[20] (about=Ifeoma, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Ifeoma suggests setting up a standing order for the fund next year to avoid Adaeze chasing anyone.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Ifeoma, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) The group will set up a standing order for the fund in January to avoid Adaeze chasing anyone.
[22] (about=Kingsley, core, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Kingsley booked the venue for the summer party on Wednesday, confirmation is in his email, and he forwarded it to Adaeze.
[23] (about=Kingsley, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley proposes a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.
[24] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kingsley, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley will host a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.
[25] (about=Nkechi, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Nkechi says Adaeze carries too much and does not complain, and she is proud of her; they will discuss this properly in December.
[26] (about=Nkechi, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Nkechi asks Tobenna to confirm April, Kingsley to sort the Christmas fund half before Friday, and notes they will have a good Christmas and proper Leeds trip.
[27] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) The family will discuss Adaeze's workload and the fund setup properly in December.
[28] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states Adaeze does the fund chasing every year and suggests Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility, as Adaeze should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
[29] (about=Obiageli, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Obiageli insists someone else in the family should learn the fund process from Adaeze now, not next year.
agent_answer: B. Chisom — her message was more emotional and personally empathetic (“😭 I see you”), unlike Ifeoma’s measured, agenda-focused phrasing that came immediately before.
